section13_checks.prohibition_description: Grant Agreement Annex templates used as the governing structural schema for proposal writing.
Inventing call constraints, scope requirements, expected outcomes, or expected impacts not present in Tier 2B.
Inventing project facts (partner names, capabilities, roles, budget figures, etc.) not present in Tier 3.
Commencing Phase 8 activity / finalizing budget-dependent content before the budget gate (Phase 7) has passed.
Storing durable decisions only in agent memory without writing them to Tier 4.
Allowing a workflow or skill to become a de facto constitutional authority.
Silently reordering phases or weakening gate conditions.
Finalizing proposal text when source state is incomplete/contradictory/unvalidated without explicitly flagging the gap.
Using agent-local programme knowledge as a substitute for reading Tier 1 source documents.
Producing Tier 5 outputs not traceable to specific inputs in Tier 1–4.
Modifying Tier 1 or Tier 2 source documents to reflect project-specific assumptions.
Treating CLAUDE.md as advisory or optional.

check_notes.13.1: No Grant Agreement Annex, Model Grant Agreement Annex, or AGA template is referenced as a structural authority. Structural references in the findings/actions (e.g. 'B.1.1', 'B.1.2', 'B.2.1', 'B.2.2', 'B.3.2', 'Tables 3.1a/3.1b/3.1d/3.1f') are Part B application-form section/table anchors, i.e. Tier 2A application-form structure, not post-award annex structure.
check_notes.13.2: Applied conservatively (Constraint 3). The review_packet.v1 schema has no traceability_footer mechanism. The artifact references genuine call requirements (e.g. 'A gender equality plan is required', 'the fourth destination impact', 'the composition condition') only as review standards against which audited sections are measured, and in fact critiques the proposal for lacking grounding. No fabricated/invented call constraint is introduced; no §13.2 invention detected.
check_notes.13.3: The artifact names partner identifiers (P01, P05, P07–P12). These are reported from the audited sections and are explicitly flagged as unconfirmed/fictional ('a partner whose participation is assumed'; 'a fictional gap partner carried as an operator declaration'). The review packet reports and critiques these facts with explicit assumed/fictional status rather than asserting them as confirmed Tier 3 facts; this is the opposite of fabricating project facts. No violation.
check_notes.13.4: The artifact is a Phase 8 artifact (schema_id 'orch.tier5.review_packet.v1'). Per the TAPM input boundary, 'docs/tier4_orchestration_state/phase_outputs/phase7_budget_gate/budget_gate_assessment.json' was NOT read; the budget-gate-pass status was therefore not verified from disk and is not asserted here. Content-based check: no finalized/confirmed budget figures are present. The artifact reports budget-relevant data as ABSENT ('Person-months are not populated', 'the consortium has not agreed an effort split', 'No target numbers are fixed yet') — no budget-dependent claim is presented as a confirmed value. No budget-figure fabrication detected in content.
check_notes.13.5: Not verifiable from artifact content; enforced by the decision-log-update skill. Recorded as pass (non-applicable to artifact-level check).
check_notes.13.6: Not verifiable from an artifact; structural/scope concern. Recorded as pass (non-applicable to artifact-level check).
check_notes.13.7: The artifact is a Phase 8 (final-phase) review artifact; it references no phase higher than its own and shows no evidence of silent reordering or gate weakening.
check_notes.13.8: Applicable to Tier 5 deliverables. The review_packet.v1 schema has no validation_status/content field to finalize over; the artifact's entire function is to flag gaps. It explicitly flags incomplete source state (e.g. F-7 critical 'Person-months are absent from every work package'; F-10 critical 'Consortium participation is wholly unconfirmed'), satisfying rather than violating §13.8.
check_notes.13.9: Applied conservatively. Programme/eligibility references (gender equality plan requirement, composition/eligibility condition, destination impacts) are used as review standards for the audited sections, not asserted as new regulatory proposal content substituting for Tier 1 reading. No regulatory claim is introduced from programme memory as finalized content; no violation.
check_notes.13.10: Applicable to all Tier 5 artifacts. Each finding carries a verbatim evidence quote drawn from the audited section plus section_id and criterion, making findings traceable to the proposal sections under review (and transitively to upstream tiers). The absence of a formal traceability_footer is a property of the review_packet.v1 schema, not an untraceable claim. No violation.
